# Top-level tests that do not call t.Parallel, read by internal/lint/paralleltests.
# One line for each test: package TestName reason
# package is the import path below the module path. The reason says what shared state the test writes.
# A serial test runs before any parallel test of its package resumes, so no running test reads the state while it changes.
internal/server TestBodyOverTheLimitAnswersTooLarge LowerLimits writes the package size limits that every running server reads
internal/server TestLargestObjectIsStored LowerLimits writes the package size limits that every running server reads
internal/server TestLargeTreeIsRead LowerLimits writes the package size limits that every running server reads
internal/server TestObjectsBodyStartingWithAHugeTokenAnswersTooLarge LowerLimits writes the package size limits that every running server reads
internal/gitpack TestUnpackCountsWholeObjectsInTheResolvedTotal it writes the package variable unpackLimit that every Unpack reads
internal/land TestTheLimitCountsDistinctPaths it writes the package variable MaxChangedPaths that every land reads
internal/land TestTheCacheOfBaseDiffsIsBounded it writes the package variable MaxChangedPaths that every land reads
internal/land TestALandThatMakesAnObjectAboveTheLimitFailsAloneAndLeavesNoTrace it writes the package variable MaxObjectBytes that every land reads
internal/server TestTheMemoryBudgetAndTheFetchSlotsOnOneServer LowerFetchSlots writes the package variables that every running server reads
internal/store TestSlowReadsGetASpanAtMostOnceASecond sets the global tracer provider
